slides.text: Why nobody local is finding your firm
slides.voiceover_text: Here's why local customers aren't finding your firm. Three boring fixes most owners ignore.

slides.text: Complete every field on your Google profile
slides.voiceover_text: One. Complete every field on your Google profile. Hours, services, areas, photos. The half-done profile is invisible to half your searchers.

slides.text: Ask clients to mention the town in reviews
slides.voiceover_text: Two. Ask clients to mention the town in reviews. A review that names the place beats fifty generic five-stars.
